route_title: Optimization of 10-Layer All-Dielectric Polarizing Beam Splitter
compilation_rationale: The request specifies a fixed 10-layer stack with explicit materials (Ta2O5, SiO2) and bounds. This is a valid bounded TMM optimization task. TE/TM polarizations map to s/p. Robustness parameters are mapped to the uncertainty object. The 'fewer layers' preference is ignored as the layer count is fixed at 10 by the compiler policy directive.
